For Indian heat, I’d prioritise fresh/aquatic or clean woody scents that can last through a workday without becoming too loud.

Perfume	Approx. price	What differentiates it
Rasasi Hawas EDP	₹3,000–₹3,800	Fresh aquatic, slightly sweet; particularly suited to hot/humid weather. ~6–8+ hrs. 
Perfumes by Janta Shoppe

Armaf Club de Nuit Intense Man EDT	₹3,000–₹4,100	Smoky pineapple + woody profile; stronger and more assertive, with ~6–8+ hrs longevity. 
Perfumes by Janta Shoppe
+1

Ajmal Kuro EDP	~₹2,700	Clean citrus/lavender/spicy profile; more understated and office-friendly. ~5–7 hrs. 
Perfumes by Janta Shoppe

For daily Bangalore office wear: Hawas is the easiest fit; Kuro is the quieter option; CDNIM is better if you want more presence.
